proof.observed: three heartbeats after the restore: isStreaming true, queuedMessageCount 0, no card; after the turn ended on its own: exactly one inert card ('runs no side turn and needs no answer'), still one three heartbeats later; 1 agent_start and 1 turn_start since the prompt; no assistant message after the card
proof.negativeControl: the same leg against the plugin at cdc5696f (round 3 head) fails: 'omp holds a message for its streaming turn 1s after the restart ... queuedMessageCount 1'

proof.criterion: UnwrittenFrames never hands an inert card to a host that is not settled, and hands a held one once at the first settled moment
proof.surface: pi-envoy bun test (src/unwritten-frames.test.ts, describe 'an inert card')
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && bun test (999 pass, 0 fail at 6f57a71c)
proof.observed: held while busy (queued, waitsOnCard, claim pending), handed once as inert at handBackWithdrawn(true), not at handBackWithdrawn(false); a failed hand retries at the next settled moment; a session move drops it and releases its claim
proof.negativeControl: with the hold disabled (const hand = true) four of the five new tests fail

proof.criterion: readArrivals yields every frame it read before a subscription's clean end or error, as nats.js's own iterator does
proof.surface: envoy-client bun test (src/__tests__/delivery-arrivals.test.ts) driving nats 2.29.3's real QueuedIteratorImpl
proof.command: cd packages/envoy-client && bun test (909 pass, 0 fail at 6f57a71c)
proof.observed: clean stop while the caller is busy: a, b, c yielded then done, equal to the raw iterator's output; stop with an error: frames read first, then the error; break stops the source
proof.negativeControl: against round 3's delivery.ts all three tests fail (clean stop yields only the first frame)

trickyParts: hostSettled (idle, no pending message, not shutting down, on this session) is one function used both by UnwrittenFrames.sendCard and the heartbeat's handBackWithdrawn, so the two gates cannot drift.

A held inert card has handedAt undefined, so handBackWithdrawn's 'just handed' age guard does not skip it; it is handed at the first settled tick, before that tick's sweep, which then finds the frame still waiting on its card.
readArrivals returns the source iterator when the caller leaves early; nats.js takes the return only after its read in flight settles.
